title: 第3章 他是天生的杀神

content_zh:
此时，所有的利箭都以密林里的娇小身影为终点，数箭齐发，即便是神仙，不死也难。
就在看似尘埃落定的时刻，紫色华服被玉绯烟展开，以常人难以理解的状态，形成一道紫色漩涡，将百来支利箭卷入其中，吸附进去。
强大的冲击力将玉绯烟撞在地上，可她却松了口气。
还好，躲过一劫！
没等玉绯烟喘口气，又一阵箭雨从丛林里射出。
擦，有完没完啊！
玉绯烟弹跳起来。
“堂堂四海阁风堂主居然屈尊为难一只小野猫，说出去也不怕江湖人笑话！”
就在危急时刻，一个清贵的声音传来，随后，一道白花花的身影出现在玉绯烟面前。
哥，您能先穿衣服么？
见到来人，玉绯烟连忙掩住鼻子，防止再次流血。
“表现不错！没给我丢脸！”
夏侯擎天不咸不淡地瞥了眼玉绯烟的鼻子，抽出被利箭穿孔的华服披上，随后抱起狼狈的玉绯烟跃起，右手漫不经心地一挥，原本被华服收拢的利箭以他为中心，迅猛地飞射回去。
“砰砰砰——”
随着一连串沉重的声音，十来个黑衣人从林子里栽了出来，各个一箭封喉，死相狰狞，浓烈的血腥气立刻在纯净的空气中蔓延开来。
极品高手！
太厉害了——
玉绯烟睁大眼睛，抓着夏侯擎天衣袖的手竟然兴奋得有些颤抖。
那轻飘飘的一挥手看似绵软无力，没想到这么厉害，看来刚才在温泉他对自己手下留情了。
夏侯擎天原以为玉绯烟见到血腥吓得发抖，可在对上那双如同野生小兽似的犀利眸子后，才发现她是在激动。

这脾性，对他胃口！
夏侯擎天嘴角微微上扬，显示出了他愉悦的心情。
“哼！你终于出来了！今天就是你的死期！”林风从隐匿处站了出来，跟在他身后的六个黑衣人看上去气场不弱。
原来这些人的目标是他，自己无辜当了替罪羊！
玉绯烟一阵懊恼，早知道就不该捎走他的衣服，定是紫色华服让他们以为她和这个男人有关系，害她差点丧命。
觉察到玉绯烟的郁闷，夏侯擎天抱着她的手臂紧了紧，嘴角笑意更浓。
他原本打算去找她，没想到她却自投罗网了。
真是只“善解人意”的猫儿！
“爷现在心情不错，所以大发慈悲，给你们留个全尸！你们，一起上吧——”
看着面前七人的架势，夏侯擎天笑得高洁无瑕。
他轻描淡写丢出一句话，仿佛碾死这些人是一件再简单不过的事情，也愈发刺激了林风等人。
见夏侯擎天要出手，玉绯烟眼里的小火苗瞬间被点燃。
观摩高手出战是极好的学习机会！更何况这个世界和她以前的认知完全不同，正好借此机会恶补一下欠缺的知识。
想到这儿，玉绯烟抱紧了夏侯擎天的脖子。她可不想在他杀人的时候跌落出去，成为敌人的攻击目标。
玉绯烟贴过来的香软身子，让夏侯擎天微微一怔。
一股若有若无的清香从玉绯烟纤细柔弱的颈部散发出来。
不同于脂粉香和熏香，这是一种属于少女的独特味道，清纯的甜香缓缓地刺激着男子敏感的嗅觉，撩动着他沉睡了多年的心。
这算是……投怀送抱？
觉悟很高，不错！
心情畅快的夏侯擎天难得体贴了一回，毫不在乎自己身处险境，低头看向怀里的小人儿，“怎么，想看爷杀人？”

“想！”
玉绯烟一愣，老老实实地点了点头，声音娇柔乖巧，听得人神清气爽。
“看好了！”
夏侯擎天跃起，迎上一黑衣人。
没有防守，也没有任何花哨招式。
夏侯擎天完全无视从头顶劈下的锋利长刀，只是长驱直入的暴力进攻，大手瞬间锁在对方的咽喉，一招定胜负。
“咔嚓——”
那人根本没有时间还击，就软软地躺在了地上。
“厉害！”玉绯烟惊叹道，只见她眼前场景晃动了几下，方才还在叫嚣的林风已经倒地不起。至于其他人，更是变成挺尸。
果然，进攻才是最好的防守！在绝对强悍的武力面前，神马都是浮云。
刚才的整个过程干净利落，毫不拖泥带水，她在夏侯擎天怀里看得真真切切。这是个杀伐决断，又犀利冷酷的男人！
“还满意你看到的？”
夏侯擎天站在草地上，紫色的华服上绣着盛开的鸢尾花，愈发衬得他清贵高华。

content_en:
At this time, all the sharp arrows were aimed at the petite figure in the dense forest. Several arrows were fired in unison. It would be difficult for even a god not to die.
Just when the dust seemed to have settled, the purple robe was unfolded by the jade Fei Yan, forming a purple vortex in a state that was difficult for ordinary people to understand, and hundreds of sharp arrows were drawn into it and sucked into it.
The powerful impact knocked Yu Feiyan to the ground, but she breathed a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, I escaped a disaster!
Before Yu Feiyan could take a breath, another hail of arrows shot out from the jungle.
Wipe it, it’s not over yet!
Jade Feiyan jumped up.
"The majestic Sihai Pavilion Feng Hall Master actually condescended to embarrass a little wild cat, and he is not afraid of the ridicule of the people in the world!"
At the critical moment, a noble voice came, and then, a white figure appeared in front of Yu Feiyan.
Brother, can you get dressed first?
Seeing the visitor, Yu Feiyan quickly covered her nose to prevent bleeding again.
"Good performance! You didn't embarrass me!"
Xiahou Qingtian glanced at Yu Feiyan's nose without saltiness, took out the Chinese clothes that were pierced by sharp arrows and put them on, then he picked up the embarrassed Yu Feiyan and jumped up. He waved his right hand casually, and the sharp arrows that were originally gathered in the clothes flew back quickly with him as the center.
"Bang bang bang——"
Following a series of heavy sounds, a dozen men in black jumped out of the forest, each with an arrow to seal their throats. They died with a ferocious look. The strong smell of blood immediately spread in the pure air.
The best master!
So awesome——
Yu Feiyan's eyes widened, and the hand holding Xiahou Qingtian's sleeve was trembling with excitement.
That light wave of his hand seemed weak and weak, but he didn't expect it to be so powerful. It seemed that he had been merciful to him in the hot spring just now.
Xia Hou Qingtian originally thought that Yu Feiyan was trembling with fear at the sight of blood, but after meeting those sharp eyes like wild animals, he realized that she was excited.
This temperament suits him!
The corners of Xiahou Qingtian's mouth rose slightly, showing his joyful mood.
"Hmph! You finally came out! Today is the day you die!" Lin Feng stood up from his hiding place, and the six men in black following him looked strong.
It turns out that these people were targeting him, and he was innocently made the scapegoat!
Yu Feiyan was annoyed for a moment. She should have known better than to take away his clothes. It must have been the purple clothes that made them think she was related to this man, which almost killed her.
Sensing Yu Feiyan's depression, Xiahou Qingtian held her arms tightly, and the smile on his lips became wider.
He originally planned to find her, but he didn't expect that she would fall into a trap.
What an "understanding" cat!
"I'm in a good mood now, so I'm showing mercy and leaving a whole body for you! You guys, come together -"
Looking at the postures of the seven people in front of him, Xiahou Qingtian smiled elegantly.
He said it lightly, as if crushing these people to death was a simple matter, which further irritated Lin Feng and others.
Seeing that Xiahou Qingtian was about to take action, the small flames in Yu Feiyan's eyes were instantly ignited.
Watching the masters compete is an excellent learning opportunity! What's more, this world is completely different from what she knew before, so it's just a good opportunity to make up for the lack of knowledge.
Thinking of this, Yu Feiyan hugged Xiahou Qingtian's neck tightly. She didn't want to fall out while he was killing people and become the enemy's target.
Xiahou Qingtian was slightly startled by Yu Feiyan's fragrant and soft body.
A vague fragrance emanates from Yu Feiyan's slender and weak neck.
Different from the scent of powder and incense, this is a unique scent that belongs to girls. The pure sweet scent slowly stimulates the man's sensitive sense of smell and stirs up his heart that has been sleeping for many years.
Is this... a throw-in?
The consciousness is very high, not bad!
Xia Hou Qingtian, who was in a happy mood, was considerate for a rare moment. He didn't care that he was in danger. He lowered his head and looked at the little man in his arms, "What, you want to see me kill someone?"
"Think!"
Jade FeiyanAfter being stunned for a moment, he nodded honestly, his voice was soft and sweet, which made people feel refreshed.
"Watch it!"
Xiahou Qingtian jumped up and met a man in black.
There is no defense and no fancy moves.
Xiahou Qingtian completely ignored the sharp knife slashed from the top of his head and just launched a violent attack. His big hand instantly locked on the opponent's throat, deciding the outcome with one move.
"Click——"
The man didn't have time to fight back, so he lay softly on the ground.
"Awesome!" Yu Feiyan exclaimed, and saw the scene in front of her shaking a few times, and Lin Feng, who was still shouting just now, fell to the ground. As for the others, they turned into corpses.
Sure enough, offense is the best defense! In the face of absolutely powerful force, all gods and horses are like clouds.
The whole process just now was clean and neat, without any sloppiness. She could see it clearly in Xiahou Qingtian's arms. This is a man who is decisive, sharp and cold!
"Are you satisfied with what you see?"
Xiahou Qingtian stood on the grass, his purple clothes embroidered with blooming iris flowers, which made him even more noble and elegant.
